scenario: s5: spawnAgent in a parent, the child's own thread, the parent's sub-agent notification
note: parent.json and child.json are thread/read responses; the child's own rollout was not recorded, only the parent's.
sanitization: The local working directory is replaced by /work (also inside file:// URLs).
The local home directory /Users/<name>/ is replaced by /home/user/ and any remaining occurrence of the local user name by user.
Keys dropped everywhere: creator_user_id, creator_account_id, session_id, sessionId, base_instructions, rate_limits, originator, path, environments, cwd of a thread, backwardsCursor, metadata.
Encrypted reasoning blobs (encrypted_content) are replaced by the placeholder <encrypted>.
Rollout lines dropped whole: response_item/additional_tools, response_item/message with role developer, and role user messages that are the AGENTS.md or environment-context injections.

Rollout bookkeeping lines are reduced to the few fields that name them: session_meta (id, timestamp, cli_version, forked_from_id, history_mode), turn_context (turn_id, root_turn_id, model), world_state (state replaced by <dropped>), compacted (message and replacement_history replaced by <dropped>), thread_settings_applied (payload type only).
Any string longer than 400 characters is cut to its first 400 characters followed by [truncated] (only tool output and tool-call source are affected).
Every other field the parser reads (ids, clientIds, turn ids, timestamps, content, statuses, usage numbers) is unchanged.
